# kwik-e-gate

Local deterministic checks and content-bound receipts for coding agents.
Python 3.11+ and Git; zero core runtime dependencies. No model or API is required.

- README.md: source install and plan → run → verify workflow.
- docs/CONFIGURATION.md: repository-owned checks, routing and optional adapters.
- docs/QUICK-GATE-JS.md: compatible npm quick-gate CLI/API and explicit repair.
- docs/MIGRATION.md: versions, existing users, Actions and release sequence.
- KWIK-E-GATE-PLAN.md: architecture, source-placement decision and validation.

The 0.4.0 consolidated candidate is local and unreleased. Run always returns a
PASS/FAIL receipt. PASS proves the declared checks ran against the bound inputs;
it is not proof of correctness or authorization to publish. plan is read-only;
verify rejects stale evidence. Optional model review is a separate command.
